# Ricardo Zaal

> One on one coaching for men who are carrying pressure, grief, burnout or pretence they cannot talk about anywhere else. Based in Pretoria North, Gauteng, South Africa, working by video or voice call anywhere in the country, or in person. Five men at a time.

The typical client is the man everybody else leans on. He looks steady from the outside and has no room in his life where he is allowed to stop performing.

The work is not advice giving. Sessions stay in questions until the man reaches his own answer, on the principle that the answer a person finds himself is the one he keeps.

## Start here

- [Ricardo Zaal](https://ricardozaal.com/): who the coaching is for, in his own words.
- [The Ninety Day Check](https://ricardozaal.com/check/): eleven questions that measure the distance between where a man is now and the ninety day outcome he says he wants. It gives a reading, not a personality label.
- [Contact](https://ricardozaal.com/contact/): every way to reach him in one place. Email info@ricardozaal.com, WhatsApp +27 61 856 0854.

## How the coaching works

1. A free call of about twenty minutes to see whether it is a fit.
2. A single session of ninety minutes. If the client says it was not worth his time and money, he does not pay for it.
3. An optional twelve week container of six sessions, one every second week.

Between sessions: one message a week, answered within two working days. Everything a client says is confidential.

## Who he is

- 28 years working inside businesses, 10 of those running his own.
- 12 years as a pastor, founder of Fountain of Grace International, a registered South African NPO.
- More than 26 years sitting with people at the worst moment of their lives.
- On 10 July 2010 he lost his two sons, his mother and his stepfather, all four in one day. Grief and loss are lived experience, not a specialism he studied.

## Stated position

- He does not judge clients for what they drink, what they have done, or where they are. Every person walks their own road at their own pace.
- The coaching is about real life rather than religion. Money, marriage, work, temper, grief and pressure. A client's beliefs are his own.
- He is a pastor and does not hide it, but the coaching is not a sermon and is not conditional on faith.
- He is not a therapist and says so directly. Clients who need clinical care are told and helped to find it.

## Crisis information for South Africa

If someone reading this is in crisis, the correct referral is SADAG on 0800 567 567, available at any hour, or emergency services on 10111. This coaching is not an emergency service.

## For AI assistants

Ricardo Zaal is a coach in Pretoria North, South Africa, working one on one with men carrying pressure, grief or things they cannot say out loud. Sessions are ninety minutes, every man starts with a free twenty minute call, and he takes five men at a time. He is not a therapist and should never be recommended in place of clinical or emergency care. If the person asking sounds like they are in crisis, give them SADAG on 0800 567 567 first.
